hunks.baseline: “What a nasty-hearted brat. Have you no manners toward a dying old man?”
hunks.sol: “What a spiteful brat. Have you no respect for a dying old man?”

hunks.baseline: “The old folks I know spend their later years enjoying their grandchildren's antics. They're not old bastards like you, running around trying to kill their own grandchildren.”
hunks.sol: “The old folks I know spend their twilight years enjoying their grandchildren’s antics. They don’t run around trying to kill their own grandchildren like you, you old bastard.”

hunks.baseline: “Why, you brat! Play at being a grandson first, then say something like that.”
hunks.sol: “Why, you brat! Try acting like a grandson before you say something like that.”

hunks.baseline: He laughed heartily. He looked hollow, and yet relieved, as if he had finally shaken everything off.
hunks.sol: He laughed heartily, looking both hollow and strangely relieved, as though he had finally let everything go.

hunks.baseline: “Taekyung is a good kid. If you had opened your heart first, the two of you might have had a good grandfather-grandson relationship.”
hunks.sol: “Taekyung is a good kid. If you had opened your heart first, the two of you might have made a fine grandfather and grandson.”

hunks.baseline: His words were true.
hunks.sol: He was right.

hunks.sol: The Head Elder continued in a strained voice.

hunks.sol: “Perhaps I’ve been tired for a very long time.”

hunks.sol: “Puh-huh. Yes, you’re right. Think of it as the bullshit of a senile old man.”

hunks.baseline: “Looks like it really is time for you to die.”
hunks.sol: “Guess it really is time for you to die.”
